consumers.usage: Its observability smoke test builds envelopes from this package, redacts them and sends them to the launched GlitchTip as JavaScript, Go and Python events, asserting that the release, environment, correlation id, incident code and component arrive; its Python helpers read schema/incident-codes.json and schema/redaction-rules.json rather than restating either. TEL-02 MOVED THE SMOKE'S IMPLEMENTATION to auto-pigeon-telemetry (scripts/smoke.sh and scripts/smoke/), which now consumes this package directly through an --aulibs path AUT hands it; what is left here is scripts/aup/observability-smoke.sh, the resolver that finds a launched stack's DSN, token, origin and releases and execs that implementation. AUT therefore still depends on this package indirectly (it passes the checkout and the releases) and no longer reads it directly. THE INC-01 DEFECT RECORDED HERE IS FIXED: verify.py indexed GlitchTip's stored events by `eventID` and matched that against each lane's `incident_id`, and INC-01 made `event_id` a fresh transport id per transmission, so every lane reported "no event with id ... arrived" although every event arrived. It now indexes by the searchable `incident_id` TAG that toSentryEvent puts on every event, and additionally asserts the `component` tag. AUP 127 FOLLOW-UP: AUT now also RESOLVES this package's directory and hands it to the AUP image as the named build context `incident-contract` — workspace_paths.py's incident_contract_dir (checked for package.json, src/index.mjs and schema/), written into .launch-aup.env as INCIDENT_CONTRACT_DIR and consumed by docker-compose.apps.yml, exactly as apmap-contract and game-params already were. It still does not READ the package. This exists because auto-pigeon/frontend/package.json depends on it by relative path, which OBS-02 added with no way for it to reach a Docker build: the AUP image did not build at all from ddf3bdf until AUP 127, npm ci linking nothing and tsc -b failing with six TS2307s, unnoticed because no ordinary test lane runs docker build. tests/test_incident_contract_context.sh is that lane. No package file was changed; this row is the only write.

The editor's whole incident subsystem is built on it (OBS-02). services/incidents.ts uses createIncident, redactValue, validateIncident, newCorrelationId/isCorrelationId and the schema version; services/incidentTransport.ts uses toSentryEvent to POST to the self-hosted GlitchTip's store endpoint, with no Sentry SDK; services/bugReport.ts uses toDiagnosticText, redactText and BUG_REPORT_URL for the sanitised report and the prefilled public issue; services/api.ts puts CORRELATION_HEADER on every outbound request. The incident CODES are read from the taxonomy rather than restated: render.*, editor.*, aub.*, auc.*, aue.* and reporting.telemetry_unavailable are all used as written there.

OBS-03. internal/incident/contract/ holds BYTE-FOR-BYTE copies of schema/incident-codes.json, schema/redaction-rules.json and schema/incident-envelope-1.0.schema.json, embedded with go:embed so the container image builds with no sibling checkout; TestEmbeddedContractIsExactlyAULIBS compares each against this package and fails the build on drift (it skips, loudly, when no sibling checkout is present). internal/incident implements the envelope, on-demand validation, the taxonomy lookup and the three kinds of redaction rule as READERS of that data rather than as transcriptions, and asserts that every value pattern compiles unchanged in Go's RE2. internal/correlation implements the correlation convention: header X-Auto-Pigeon-Correlation-Id, 32 lowercase hex, malformed treated as absent and never forwarded, and the correlation_id column AUB stores on the AUE job so AUE inherits it. Codes used as written here: aub.error, aue.unavailable, aue.timeout, auc.disconnected, auc.error, reporting.telemetry_unavailable. No package code was changed by AUB; this file is the only write.

OBS-06. The gallery's whole incident subsystem is built on it. src/incidents/incidents.ts uses createIncident, redactValue/redactText, validateIncident, toDiagnosticText and newCorrelationId/isCorrelationId; src/incidents/transport.ts uses toSentryEvent to POST to the self-hosted GlitchTip's store endpoint, with no Sentry SDK, for the reasons AUP recorded in OBS-02; src/incidents/bugReport.ts uses toDiagnosticText, redactText and BUG_REPORT_URL; src/gallery/api.ts and src/auth/pocketbase.ts put correlationHeaders on every outbound AUB request. AUG raises exactly one code, aug.error, which is the one the taxonomy assigns it — the distinction between its failure kinds travels on `subsystem` (aub, aub.payload, auth, auth.invitation, assets, config, render, window, boundary), which toSentryEvent promotes to a GlitchTip tag. The taxonomy was NOT extended, deliberately: AUB and AUE each embed a byte-for-byte copy of schema/incident-codes.json behind a drift test that fails when it changes, and neither was a mutation target of that prompt. IMPORTANT: this repository holds a byte-for-byte VENDORED copy of the whole package at vendor/incident-contract/, wired as `file:vendor/incident-contract`, because AGENTS.md §6 requires `docker build .` to succeed and a dependency resolving outside the build context fails `npm ci`; vite/incidentContractDrift.test.ts compares all 13 files against this package and fails on drift, skipping loudly when no sibling checkout is present. No package code was changed by AUG; this file is the only write.

OBS-04R. AUC's whole incident subsystem is built on it, and until that task AUC reported NOTHING - no dependency, no DSN key, no envelope, which glitchtip.sh recorded in prose while skipping it. src/incidents.ts uses createIncident, incidentCode, isCorrelationId, redactIncident and validateIncident; src/incident-transport.ts uses toSentryEvent to POST to the self-hosted GlitchTip's store endpoint, with no Sentry SDK, for the reasons AUP recorded in OBS-02. TWO THINGS ARE SPECIFIC TO AUC. (1) It holds a byte-for-byte VENDORED copy of the whole package at vendor/incident-contract/, wired as `file:vendor/incident-contract`, because its Dockerfile runs `npm ci` in two stages from a build context of that repository and a dependency resolving outside it fails there; test/incident-contract-drift.test.ts compares all 13 files against this package and fails on drift, skipping loudly with no sibling checkout - the same arrangement AUG has. (2) It redacts at RAISE time as well as in toSentryEvent, because a server's local ring buffer is read by whoever is diagnosing an instance rather than by the person the incident is about, and this process's strings can reach a token, an internal address or a filesystem path. The taxonomy was NOT extended, deliberately, for the reason AUG gives above: what distinguishes one AUC fault from another travels on `subsystem` (startup, room.create, room.dispose, room.handler, room.egress, journal, checkpoint, aub, admission, heartbeat, ownership, lease), which toSentryEvent promotes to a GlitchTip tag. Codes used as written here: auc.disconnected, auc.backpressure, auc.error, aub.unavailable, aub.timeout, aub.error. No package code was changed by AUC; this file is the only write.

TEL-02. The observability smoke test's implementation lives here: scripts/smoke/prepare.mjs imports createIncident, validateIncident, toSentryEvent and isCorrelationId from this package's src/index.mjs to build three synthetic incidents (AUP/render.3d, AUE/wad, AUT/observability) carrying one correlation id and deliberate fake secrets, redacts them through toSentryEvent, and fails BEFORE sending if a fake secret survived; the three send lanes transmit the resulting events with the real Sentry SDK for JavaScript, Go and Python, and scripts/smoke/verify.py reads them back out of GlitchTip and asserts the release, environment, correlation_id, incident_code and component tags plus the absence of every planted secret. THE CONTRACT IS NEVER COPIED HERE: the AULIBS checkout is passed in as --aulibs by whoever runs the smoke, and the script refuses rather than falling back when that path holds no ts/incident-contract. No package code was changed by TEL-02 other than this file.
